header: TIN
definition: Exact workbook TIN key; preserve as text. Eight-digit source keys are not silently padded.

header: NPI
definition: Exact organization NPI linking workbook TIN to MSSP prospective SAS source.

header: Organization
definition: Organization name from workbook TIN selection.

header: Performance year
definition: 2027, supplied workbook configuration.

header: BY3 year
definition: 2026, supplied workbook configuration.

header: Assignment methodology
definition: Prospective, supplied workbook configuration.

header: MSSP track
definition: ENHANCED, supplied workbook configuration.

header: BY3 aligned beneficiaries - eligibility
definition: Observed 2026 source total BENES; missing/-11 total uses treated cohort member months / 5. Inclusion >=200.

header: BY3 total treated member months
definition: Sum of four 2026 cohort member months after user missing-value treatment.

header: Projected beneficiaries
definition: MSSP Shared Saving Losses!B7.

header: Projected person years
definition: MSSP Shared Saving Losses!B8.

header: Projected annual expense per person year
definition: MSSP Shared Saving Losses!B19.

header: Projected annual benchmark per person year
definition: MSSP Shared Saving Losses!B20.

header: Projected expenditures
definition: MSSP Shared Saving Losses!B21.

header: Projected benchmark
definition: MSSP Shared Saving Losses!B22.

header: Gross margin before sharing
definition: Projected benchmark less projected expenditures.

header: Pre-sharing MLR
definition: Expenditures / benchmark; blank if benchmark is missing or nonpositive.

header: Shared savings - original model
definition: MSSP Shared Saving Losses!B39, preserves original uncapped workbook formula.

header: Shared losses signed - original model
definition: MSSP Shared Saving Losses!B40, negative when losses are payable; preserves original uncapped workbook formula.

header: Net shared result - original model
definition: Shared savings plus signed shared losses; positive means savings, negative means payable losses.

header: Post-sharing MLR - original model
definition: Original model B41: 1 - (shared savings + signed shared losses) / benchmark; blank if benchmark missing/nonpositive.

header: MLR validity
definition: Defined only when projected benchmark is positive and both pre/post MLR are numeric.

header: Savings exceed listed 20% benchmark cap
definition: Review flag only: original shared savings >20% of positive benchmark. Does not adjust model output.

header: Losses exceed listed 15% benchmark cap
definition: Review flag only: absolute original signed shared losses >15% of positive benchmark. Does not adjust model output.

header: Sharing formulas apply listed caps
definition: False: original B39/B40 do not reference or apply listed track caps.

header: Qualifying TINs sharing this NPI - count
definition: Includes this TIN. Summing rows with the same NPI double-counts their underlying source population.

header: Qualifying TINs sharing this NPI - identifiers
definition: All qualifying TIN identifiers for this exact NPI, separated by semicolons.

header: Source years present
definition: Provider SAS source years present; absent years are unavailable, not synthesized.

header: Source years missing
definition: Absent provider SAS years between 2019 and 2026.

header: Calculation status
definition: Formula evaluation status; input flags and original assumptions remain separate.

header: Unhandled formula error count
definition: Evaluation errors not handled by the original model formula.

header: Unavailable source component count
definition: Blank source values and absent years across the exported source components.

header: Source issue count
definition: Count of intake issue records for this NPI.

header: Source issue codes
definition: Counts of issue codes detected during source preparation.

header: County records used
definition: Selected NPI 2026 assigned county records.

header: Distinct assigned county keys
definition: Exact assigned county keys for this NPI.

header: Unmatched assigned county keys
definition: County keys absent from the national SAS county universe; blank means none.

header: Source population key
definition: NPI: plus exact NPI source identifier.

header: 2026 MSSP claims - TIN total source PAID_RAW USD
definition: Direct supplied aggregate paid amount (or sum of four cohorts). PAID_TOT reconciles to the seven category fields; PAID_RAW is a distinct supplied cost basis. No unsupported adjustment is inferred.

header: 2026 MSSP claims - TIN total source PAID_RAW PMPM
definition: Supplied aggregate paid USD divided by treated cohort or TIN member months. Zero exposure gives unavailable PMPM.

header: 2026 MSSP claims - TIN total categories less PAID_TOT USD
definition: Sum of seven supplied category dollar fields minus supplied PAID_TOT. Small residuals may reflect floating-point arithmetic.

header: 2026 MSSP claims - ESRD source PAID_ANNUALIZED
definition: Preserved supplied annualized expenditure rate with blank dollars treated as zero. Do not substitute for PAID_TOT or force equality to PAID_RAW / treated exposure; source and suppression differences are preserved.

header: 2026 MSSP claims - Disabled source PAID_ANNUALIZED
definition: Preserved supplied annualized expenditure rate with blank dollars treated as zero. Do not substitute for PAID_TOT or force equality to PAID_RAW / treated exposure; source and suppression differences are preserved.

header: 2026 MSSP claims - Aged dual source PAID_ANNUALIZED
definition: Preserved supplied annualized expenditure rate with blank dollars treated as zero. Do not substitute for PAID_TOT or force equality to PAID_RAW / treated exposure; source and suppression differences are preserved.

header: 2026 MSSP claims - Aged nondual source PAID_ANNUALIZED
definition: Preserved supplied annualized expenditure rate with blank dollars treated as zero. Do not substitute for PAID_TOT or force equality to PAID_RAW / treated exposure; source and suppression differences are preserved.

header: 2026 MSSP claims - TIN total model truncated paid numerator USD
definition: Sum of cohort PAID_TRUNC × treated member months / 12. This is the financial model cost basis, distinct from supplied PAID_TOT and category dollars.

header: 2026 MSSP claims - TIN total model truncated expense PMPM
definition: Model truncated paid numerator divided by total treated member months.

header: 2026 MSSP claims category availability
definition: Source year availability and category cost basis. A missing source year is not converted to zero.
